my_range <- function(x){
    return (max(x) - min(x))
}
standardize <- function(x){
    return ((x - mean(x))/sd(x))
}
my_summary <- function(x){
    result <- list(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    return (result)
}

test_data <- c(12, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 30)

my_range(test_data)
standardize(test_data)
my_summary(test_data)

x <- matrix(rexp(6000000), ncol = 6000)
system.time(sweep(x,2,colSums(x), FUN = '/'))


x <- seq(-4,4,by = 0.1)
y <- seq(-4,4,by = 0.1)

data <- expand.grid(x,y)
func <- function(x,y){
    return ((1.5-x+x*y)**2 + (2.25-x+x*y**2)**2 + (2.625-x+x*y**3)**2)
}
result <- func(data[,1],data[,2])
min(result)
data[which.min(result),]
